name: PPNS — one unread GMR outcome waiting in the box

comment: HMRC nests the outcome as a JSON *string* in `message`, not as an object — the
worker has to deserialise it a second time. Getting that wrong is the most likely
integration bug, so the stub reproduces the double encoding exactly.
This mapping deliberately does NOT use response templating, unlike the GVMS ones.
Handlebars parses the response body before it is sent, and the backslash-escaped
quotes inside `message` are a parse error to it — WireMock answers 500 with a
HandlebarsException instead of the notification. The cost is that boxId is a fixed
value rather than an echo of the request; keep it in step with HMRC_PPNS_BOX_ID
This is the opening state of the `gmr-outcome` scenario. Acknowledging the
notification advances it to Acknowledged and the box goes empty, so the polling
